Rel Progress Report - Product Development and Product Improvement

PRODUCT DEVELOPMENT

1. Project RCL - Nothing specific to report.

2. Project TC - SIR has located 100 CARLTON smokers to participate in a blind paired-comparison test of 1-mg "tar" delivery CARLTON 100's Filter Cigarettes fabricated with pre-perforated tipping versus on-machine laser perforation. Both products incorporate the modified tobacco blend formulation (GH-35B). Ref. 654 cigarette paper and 35-mm tipping overwrap. Cigarettes have been forwarded to SIR for distribution. Top-line data is expected in mid-July. Similar model cigarettes are being prepared delivering 3-mg "tar" for further consumer testing to firmly establish the effect of on-machine laser perforation on cigarette taste characteristics and smoking appeal.

SIR has located about 80% of the 450 participants requested for testing l-mg "tar" delivery CARLTON King Size Filter Cigarettes prepared with the standard CARLTON tobacco blend and the modified formulation designated CFH-35B. Panel recruitment is expected to be completed next week.
We acknowledge marketing plans to discontinue 1-mg "tar" delivery CARLTON 100's Filter Soft Pack Cigarettes in the Omaha, Nebraska test area and to extend market testing of 1-mg CARLTON 100's Filter Box incorporating the modified blend (CFH-35B) to the Jacksonville, Florida warehouse area.
Eleven competitive king size filter and menthol cigarettes have been purchased and are being cut to 70 mm and repackaged in white wrapping materials to assist market research in determining viability of a short cigarette concept. We anticipate having sufficient quantities of product available for consumer testing scheduled to begin during the week of July 10.

3. Filter Cigarette Development - We acknowledge International Marketing's request for development of a 100-mm AMERICAN Super Lights product for marketing in Japan. The product will be a full 100 mm in length and 24.75 mm in circumference, with 27-mm composite filter and 35-mm tipping overwrap. The composite filter tip will be comprised of 17 mm of filter tow and a 10-mm segment of charcoal-impregnated cellulose acetate. Initial models will be prepared with MALIBU Lights tobacco blend formulation.
